'''Gamma Base''' was the name of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].

==History==
The base was populated by a small group of Rebels around the time of the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tatooine]]. [[Rookie One]] relocated there after the [[Anchorhead Base]] was destroyed during that battle in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

It was discovered by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] and subsequently [[Battle of Hoth (0 BBY)|attacked]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces which included [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]]. Rookie One managed to shoot one walker with his [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] and made his way to the hangar and escape along with the rest of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel fleet]] as the base was overrun by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] and [[Cold assault stormtrooper|Snowtroopers]].<ref name="Rebel" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gamma Base was created for the [[1993]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]''. The planet on which Gamma Base is located is never identified in the game itself, but both the manual for the [[Wikipedia:Sega CD|Sega CD]] version and the box for the [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] version identify the ice-world as Hoth.
